name: Gutrot
abilities: Chemokinesis - a walking chemical lab that mixes and vents almost any gas from body nozzles: sulphur dioxide tear gas, nitrous oxide laughing gas, sevoflurane knockout gas (with memory loss), hydrogen chloride acid gas
Potentially lethal gases (mustard gas, hydrogen cyanide) and sleeping gas - never used on-screen
Species-targeted pheromones - lured two Way Bads to Rooter HQ (Weapon XI: Part 2)
Gas absorption through his nozzles and neutralization of unwanted gases
Immunity to poisonous and acidic gases and to Nemuina sleep dust
Enhanced intelligence and vast chemistry/biology knowledge
Enhanced jumping (cleared the buildings of Los Soledad)
weaknesses: His gas clouds drift with the wind and can endanger allies and bystanders (Animo Crackers)
Cannot absorb an Ectonurite in wisp form
Cannot replicate the Fountain of Youth's water as steam
Not immune to gases as cold as liquid nitrogen
summary: A gas-masked, mechanical-looking humanoid whose belly window shows the swirling chemicals he brews and sprays - tear gas, laughing gas, knockout gas or acid on demand.
traits: Brooklyn 'wise guy' accent modelled on Peter Falk's Columbo, complete with squint
Modelled after Koffing, Derrick J. Wyatt's favourite Pokemon; working name Rotgut
Name was technically revealed by the future Dr. Animo
Chemistry is one of Ben's weakest subjects, yet Gutrot is an expert
Omnitrix symbol sits on a gas-mask piece over his mouth
notableFeats: Defeated both Dr. Animo and his future self, gassing them into submission (Animo Crackers)
Lured two Way Bads to the Rooters' headquarters with a To'kustar pheromone (Weapon XI: Part 2)
Prepared a sleeping gas for the Krakken before Sceles Vreedle stopped it (Vreedlemania)

appearances.designNotes: Mechanical-looking humanoid in green and white with a bluish-purple black-spotted head and shoulders, green eyes, white four-fingered gloves with vambraces and black sleeves, gas nozzles on forearms, shoulders, collar, head, back and rear, green belt with white stripes and a transparent stomach window; Omnitrix symbol on the mask over his mouth.

scoring.rationale: Intellect 7 and versatility 7: an on-board chemist who can brew practically any gas - tear, laughing, knockout, acid, species-specific pheromones - which beat two Animos and herded Way Bads. Gas immunity and space survivability help him survive. Physically unremarkable and his clouds blow back on allies.

notes: Nega Ben used Nega Gutrot in And Then There Were None / And Then There Was Ben - not counted in usedBy.
Never locked in the Omnitrix (Derrick J. Wyatt).
Derrick J. Wyatt: could make a sterilizing gas but not a vaccine; possibly Kraab's freezing spray; immune to Pesky Dust.
